page.layout: One printed page, upside down on the scan. Title block at the top in large capitals (about three lines), a centred block of verse-like lines below it (about six lines), a second short block (two lines), a woodcut ornament in the middle, and a small closing line with a device at the bottom. No marginal notes. The lines are too faint and inverted to read reliably.
page.notes: The whole title block is printed upside down, and the faint lines below it may be show-through from the reverse side. The central woodcut is an ornament (a flower or knot design), not text. The small mark at bottom right looks like a device or a stamp and is not transcribed. A faint numeral at the top left is too unclear to record. Most lines are illegible because of the inversion and fading.
